notes.title: Update 05: Beyond Solar Spaceship Modes
notes.content:
In Beyond Solar, the fate of Earth depends on your ability to adapt and strategically upgrade your spaceship. As you battle alien invaders, you can shift between three distinct modes: Ultimate, Gunner, and Armored. Each mode offers unique advantages allowing you to tailor your strategy to different combat scenarios.

[b]1. Ultimate Mode: Swift Maneuverability and Precision[/b]
The Ultimate mode is your default setup, designed for swift maneuverability and focused firepower. In this mode, your spaceship benefits from:
[list][*]Swift Maneuverability: Quick and agile, allowing you to dodge enemy fire with ease.
[*]Single Gun: A reliable weapon that provides precise shots to handle enemies with low HP levels effectively.[/list]
Ultimate mode is tailored for offensive attacks, making it perfect for engaging in versatile combat scenarios. Utilize this mode to navigate through levels and unleash powerful assaults on enemy forces.

[b]2. Gunner Mode: Heavy Firepower at a Cost[/b]
When you need to bring overwhelming firepower to the battlefield, switch to Gunner mode.
This configuration includes:
[list][*]Multiple Guns: Enhanced weaponry with multiple guns, allowing you to lay down a barrage of bullets and take out numerous enemies quickly.
[*]Slower Speed: Reduced maneuverability compared to Ultimate mode, making you a bit more vulnerable to enemy attacks.[/list]
Gunner mode is ideal for situations where you need to maximize your offensive capabilities, especially against large groups of enemies or tough bosses.

[b]3. Armored Mode: Ultimate Defense[/b]
In the heat of intense battles where survival is paramount, shift to Armored mode. This mode provides:
[list][*]Invulnerability: A special ability to avoid getting hit for a short duration, providing crucial
protection during overwhelming enemy fire.
[*]No Shooting: Sacrifice offensive capabilities to focus entirely on defense.
[*]Extremely Slow Speed: Significantly reduced maneuverability, making it challenging to dodge attacks.[/list]
Armored mode is essential for withstanding heavy attacks and surviving critical moments when your ship's defenses are pushed to the limit.

[b]Tips for Strategic Mode Switching:[/b]
To master Beyond Solar Game, knowing when to switch modes is crucial. Start with Ultimate mode for balanced engagements, switch to Gunner mode when facing large enemy waves or bosses and activate Armored mode during intense enemy barrages to protect your ship.

It's important to note that these mode shifts provide temporary advantages tailored to specific 
combat needs, lasting for a limited time only. By understanding the strengths and weaknesses of each mode and switching strategically, you can effectively combat alien forces and protect Earth from alien invasion.

notes.title: Patch Note 0.2.15
notes.content:
With all the positive and constructive feedback we have received from our great fans and testers, we are happy to release our new patch 0.2.15. New elements has been added to the game as well many fixes has been applied to make the experience more stable than ever.

The below are main key elements of the latest patch:

1- Cinematic Intro: A cinematic intro is available now for the player to watch the first time they start the game or by playing it from the main menu.

2- New level design: A remake of the whole background graphic of the first stage, now with more details and depth.

3- Music fix: The music now is playing in order with the current activity of the player.

4- Screen resolution: Resolution now is only accessible from the main menu settings with only two options for full screen full HD and 4K and HD for windowed mode.

5- New animations: new weapons graphics and animations including bullets, rockets and beams.

6- Assault and Turtle mode update: Charging and activation gauges design is remodeled.

7- Arsenal Updates: The arsenal is updated with new designs and weapons names.

8- Aircraft Animation: The player aircraft now have new movement animations to be more engaging.

9- Bug fixes: Several bug fixes and stability improvements.

10- Steam page: Beyond Solar page is now live on Steam with screen shots and gameplay trailer.

Don’t forget to visit the Steam page and add it to your wish list to get the latest news on time.

Thanks and stay safe.

notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.content:
An ALPHA is born !

Beyond Solar alpha is released now for selected testers to check the following:

	1- Screen resolutions and compatibility with variety of TV's and monitors.
	2- Frame rate from deferent PC specs low and high.
	3- Music and sound effects.
	4- Weapon upgrades.
	5- Drones.
	6- Assault mode.
	7- Defense mode.
	8- Pause menu.
